jobs.title: Solution Architect (Customer Service Systems)

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte de Solutions (Systèmes de Service Client)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to design and deliver creative, scalable solutions across our global Customer Service business. In this role, you will shape the architecture of our service processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP CS, SM & SD, Service Cloud (C4C V2), SAP Field Service Management, and Asset Manager. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, developers, and implementation partners to ensure robust, future-ready service solutions.

Aufgaben:
• You design and deliver high-quality solution architectures for the Epics and initiatives you own

• You elaborate solution concepts, perform requirements engineering, and create system and program specifications

• You coordinate internal and external development partners, including quality checks and testing

• You independently perform SAP S/4HANA CS/SM/SD/FSM customizing and document system setups

• You support global implementation projects and provide third-level support for global users

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business informatics, computer science, engineering, or a comparable field

• 5+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years in a similar Solution Architect or Application Manager role

• Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Customer Service (CS), Sales & Distribution (SD) as well as experience with Service Management in S/4

• Proven ability to create architecture deliverables in both waterfall and Agile environments

• Fluency in English, with strong communication and collaboration skills

Attractive vacation entitlement

To strengthen our Legal Services team at our headquarters in Uzwil, we are looking for a motivated and business-minded Legal Counsel who combines strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues across our global organization, advising on a wide range of legal matters and supporting the business in achieving its goals in a compliant and commercially sound way.

• You draft, review, and negotiate a variety of agreements, including customer, supplier, and IT-related contracts (software, cloud, SaaS)

• You develop and enhance contract templates, policies, and legal standards, while supporting the continuous improvement of legal processes and tools

• You identify legal risks, monitor regulatory developments, and translate them into practical, business-oriented guidance

• You collaborate cross-functionally and support governance matters, ensuring effective communication with stakeholders at all levels

To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem.

• Strong knowledge of enterprise integration architecture, including APIs, event-driven architectures, master data integration, customer data management, and enterprise integration patterns

• Ability to define architecture roadmaps, lead technical governance, and translate business strategy into scalable, secure, and future-oriented solution designs

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience working in Agile (SAFe) environments and influencing business and technology decisions at senior leadership level

jobs.title: Senior Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
As a Senior Installation Supervisor at Bühler you are managing and leading a team of technician required for the installation of big and / or complex projects (X-BU, type A projects). You would be responsible for the planning, preparation and execution of the installation supervision, within scope of work associated to the assigned project. Would you like to take on this new challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

Aufgaben:
• You get sure that the personnel assigned is fully acquainted with the site specific rules, safety regulations and environmental protection measures and that they perform their work accordingly as well as you perform installation according to the specifications and engineering documents, taking into account the safety instructions, environmental protection measures and local regulations

• You monitor progress of construction against the program, and take steps to ensure the program is achieved. You initiate as required mitigation/ preventive actions to achieve target program timely with the support of the Site Manager or Project Manager

• You conduct or attend daily and weekly meetings with Bühler staff and subcontractors, ensure that the Site Manager and the Project Manager receive regular information updates as well as correct behaviour and good teamwork within the installation and commissioning team in accordance with company policy and local requirements/ regulations

• You ensure proper reporting while identify, document and communicate any deviations from customer contract as well as you are responsible for maintaining an intensive customer relationship and a high level of customer satisfaction

Anforderungen:
• Engineering degree as well as 10 years of experience as Chief Installation Supervisor or proof of sufficient skills

• Technical and commercial knowledge covering multiple disciplines

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

• Strong planning, organising and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Strong customer focus, sound judgment and decision making and problem solving skills

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Come Senior Installation Supervisor presso Bühler gestisci e guida un team di tecnici necessari per l'installazione di progetti grandi e / o complessi (X-BU, progetti di tipo A). Saresti responsabile per la pianificazione, la preparazione e l'esecuzione della supervisione dell'installazione, nell'ambito del lavoro associato al progetto assegnato. Vorresti affrontare questa nuova sfida? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione!

Aufgaben:
• Si assicura che il personale assegnato sia pienamente informato delle norme specifiche del sito, delle normative di sicurezza e delle misure di protezione ambientale e che essi svolgono il loro lavoro di conseguenza, così come si esegue l'installazione secondo le specifiche e i documenti di ingegneria, tenendo conto delle istruzioni di sicurezza, delle misure di protezione ambientale e delle normative locali

• Si monitora il progresso della costruzione contro il programma, e prendere misure per garantire che il programma è raggiunto. Si avvia come necessarie azioni di mitigazione/prevenzione per raggiungere il programma di destinazione tempestivo con il supporto del Site Manager o Project Manager

• Condurre o partecipare a riunioni giornaliere e settimanali con il personale di Bühler e subappaltatori, assicurarsi che il Site Manager e il Project Manager ricevano aggiornamenti regolari delle informazioni, nonché un comportamento corretto e un buon lavoro di squadra all'interno del team di installazione e messa in servizio in conformità con la politica aziendale e i requisiti locali / regolamenti

• Garantisci una corretta segnalazione mentre identifichi, documenti e comunichi eventuali deviazioni dal contratto del cliente e sei responsabile del mantenimento di un rapporto clienti intensivo e di un alto livello di soddisfazione del cliente

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in ingegneria e 10 anni di esperienza come sovrintendente di installazione principale o prova di competenze sufficienti

• Conoscenza tecnica e commerciale che copre più discipline

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale in inglese, tra cui la capacità di interfacciarsi efficacemente con le persone all'interno e all'esterno della società

• Forte capacità di pianificazione, organizzazione e impostazione prioritaria, con una comprovata capacità di gestione dei team

• Forte attenzione del cliente, giudizio sano e decisioni e capacità di problem solving

Möchten Sie sich dieser neuen Herausforderung stellen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

• Sie überwachen den baufortschritt gegenüber dem programm und unternehmen schritte, um sicherzustellen, dass das programm erreicht wird. Sie initiieren bei Bedarf Minderungs-/Vorbeugemaßnahmen, um das Zielprogramm rechtzeitig mit Unterstützung des Site Managers oder Projektmanagers zu erreichen

• Sie führen oder nehmen an täglichen und wöchentlichen Besprechungen mit Mitarbeitern und Subunternehmern von Bühler teil, stellen sicher, dass der Site Manager und der Projektmanager regelmäßig aktualisierte Informationen sowie korrektes Verhalten und gute Teamarbeit innerhalb des Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeteams gemäß Firmenrichtlinien und lokalen Anforderungen / Vorschriften erhalten.

• Sie stellen eine ordnungsgemäße Berichterstattung sicher, während Sie Abweichungen vom Kundenvertrag identifizieren, dokumentieren und kommunizieren, und Sie sind für die Aufrechterhaltung einer intensiven Kundenbeziehung und einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit verantwortlich.

jobs.description:
Möchten Sie die Automatisierung zukünftiger Maschinen und Anlagen aktiv mitgestalten und dabei technologische Standards setzen? Unser Geschäftsbereich Chocolate & Flavor Creation entwickelt innovative Maschinen, Anlagen und Automationslösungen für die Verarbeitung von Kakao, Schokolade, Kaffee und Nüssen. Als Technical Lead Automation Engineer PLC in unserem R&D-Team übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Automatisierungsentwicklungen und begleiten neue Technologien von der ersten Idee über die Validierung bis zur Markteininführung.

Aufgaben:
• Sie übernehmen die technische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Automatisierungsentwicklungen und begleiten neue Maschinen und Anlagen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung

• Sie konzipieren zukunftsfähige, modulare PLC-Softwarearchitekturen und entwickeln wiederverwendbare Lösungen mit Siemens und Rockwell für unsere nächste Maschinengeneration

• Sie realisieren und dokumentieren neue Funktionen für Steuerung, Visualisierung, Motion Control und Antriebstechnik und integrieren die Ergebnisse von Risikoanalysen in die Sicherheitssoftware nach DIN EN ISO 13849

• Sie planen und realisieren die Verifikation und Validierung neuer Entwicklungen – mit Unit Tests und Digital Twins ebenso wie an Prototypen, Testanlagen und bei ausgewählten Kundeneinsätzen

• Sie analysieren technologische Anforderungen und Testergebnisse, leiten daraus innovative Lösungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen ab und arbeiten eng mit Konstruktion, Product Management, Project Management sowie weiteren R&D-Fachbereichen zusammen

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Automation, Elektrotechnik, Systemtechnik, Mechatronik oder Software-Engineering beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung

• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer PLC-Software für Maschinen oder Anlagen sowie sicherer Umgang mit Siemens TIA Portal und/oder Rockwell Automation Studio

• Erfahrung in der Konzeption modularer und wiederverwendbarer Softwarearchitekturen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Safety-PLC-Programmierung, Visualisierung, Motion Control, Antriebs- und Regelungstechnik

• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis moderner Entwicklungs- und Testmethoden sowie Vertrautheit mit industriellen Kommunikationslösungen und Tools wie Git und Azure DevOps; Kenntnisse in Unit Tests, Digital Twins, Structured Text oder weiteren Programmiersprachen von Vorteil
